name: bos
description: Run deterministic workflows across a federated agentic service mesh.

interface.shortDescription: Run deterministic workflows across a federated agentic service mesh.
interface.longDescription: BOS is a platform for deterministic automated workflows across an agentic mesh of federated services. It is the required foundation for dependent products and owns the authenticated BOS platform MCP connection. BOS resolves the selected organization, inspects installed services and their readiness, governs plugin settings and enablement, and coordinates authorized platform operations with server-enforced scope, evidence, and approvals.
defaultPrompt: Audit my BOS service mesh and show which deterministic workflows are ready, blocked, or need authorization.
Make this operational workflow runnable by identifying and resolving its platform dependencies.
Trace a governed workflow across my installed services and show every approval, execution step, and result.
